## Review Checklist

### Content Requirements
- [ ] Story mentions "Ryan" at least once
- [ ] No emojis present in title or content
- [ ] Content is appropriate for young children
- [ ] Word count meets minimum (10 words)
- [ ] Title is clear and descriptive

### Constitution Compliance
- [ ] **Principle IV**: No emojis anywhere (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
- [ ] **Principle V**: Required imports present in MDX file
  - [ ] `import StoryImage` present
  - [ ] `import HeroImage` present
  - [ ] `import StoryMeta` present
- [ ] Story folder named correctly (`##-slug-format`)

### Technical Requirements
- [ ] Story number is sequential and correct
- [ ] MDX file structure is valid
- [ ] Images are optimized (WebP format)
- [ ] Image paths are correct
- [ ] All files are in correct directories

### Quality Checks
- [ ] Grammar and spelling checked
- [ ] Story flows naturally
- [ ] Images are relevant and appropriate
- [ ] Image alt text is descriptive
- [ ] No sensitive or private information

### Testing
- [ ] Preview the story locally if possible
- [ ] Check mobile responsive display
- [ ] Verify image loading
- [ ] Test navigation from story list

## Merge Instructions

Once all checklist items are completed:

1. **Approve** the pull request
2. **Merge** using "Squash and merge" to keep history clean
3. **Delete** the branch after merging
4. Verify story appears on production site
